notes: No lots ("Pirkimo objektas į dalis neskaidomas"). Procedure: simplified open competition ("supaprastintas pirkimas atviro konkurso būdu"). No performance security found in the contract draft (special-terms table lists advance payment and retention as "netaikoma"; no performance-security row). The contract's special-terms table was missing from the provided text conversion, so the original docx was re-extracted into key_work/10384200/contract_raw.txt. ESPD request Part IV contains only the general α statement on selection criteria, consistent with no qualification requirements. Contract mentions "Kokybinių kriterijų reikšmes" although evaluation is lowest price (template wording). qualification_requirements_set is 'no' per the explicit statement "Reikalavimai tiekėjo kvalifikacijai nenustatomi"; an environmental management system standard (ISO 14001/EMAS or equivalent) is nevertheless required and recorded under certificates_or_licences.
